previous_assumption: Assumed category/equipment-specific commercial responsibilities (e.g. wire rope scope for foundation rigs vs. other equipment) would need dedicated columns (wireRopeScope, supportCraneScope, groundPreparationScope, etc.) added to commercial_quotations as each new case appeared.
correction: Business explicitly confirmed these responsibilities differ by company/equipment/customer and should NOT become an ever-growing set of *Scope columns. Implemented a structured child table, quotation_scope_items (item, responsible_party client|company, notes), with a snapshot copy into work_order_scope_items at award time. Common-enough terms worth searching/filtering/comparing on (fuelScope, accommodationScope, operatorScope) stay dedicated columns on commercial_quotations/work_orders; only the long tail goes into the scope-items collection.
